nodes.label: Near-Balanced Correlated/Non-Correlated Classes (train 550/490, test 73/57)
nodes.rationale: Training set is 52.9% non-correlated / 47.1% correlated and test set 56.2% / 43.8%, so accuracy is not inflated by severe class imbalance and no resampling is needed.

nodes.label: Test Confusion Matrix (TN=45 FP=28 FN=2 TP=55)
nodes.norm_label: test confusion matrix (tn=45 fp=28 fn=2 tp=55)

nodes.label: ROC Curve (AUC = 0.7854)
nodes.rationale: Curve sits above the random-classifier diagonal and reaches TPR=1.0 at FPR~0.41, showing moderate but real discriminative power on the held-out test set.

nodes.label: Precision-Recall Curve (AP = 0.6552)
nodes.rationale: Precision plateaus around 0.60-0.67 across almost the entire recall range, confirming that high recall is achievable only at roughly two-thirds precision.

nodes.label: Model Evaluation Metrics Chart (Acc/Prec/Rec/F1 vs 0.80 threshold)
nodes.norm_label: model evaluation metrics chart (acc/prec/rec/f1 vs 0.80 threshold)
nodes.rationale: Test-set Accuracy 0.7692, Precision 0.6627, Recall 0.9649, F1 0.7857; only Recall clears the 0.80 target threshold drawn on the chart.

nodes.label: Recall-over-Precision Trade-off
nodes.rationale: Only 2 of 57 correlated pairs missed (96.5% recall) while 28 of 73 non-correlated pairs are flagged (38.4% FP rate); in security auditing a missed real vulnerability costs more than a false alarm, so the model is tuned to favor recall.

nodes.label: Domain Shift (synthetic vs real TF-IDF vocabulary)
nodes.norm_label: domain shift (synthetic vs real tf-idf vocabulary)
nodes.rationale: Model trained on synthetic descriptions; real Semgrep/HTTP scanner text shares no vocabulary so TF-IDF features ~0 and 0 ML correlations on Juice Shop; motivates fine-tuning or sentence embeddings as future work

nodes.label: Feature 509 Dominant Predictor (Gini 0.0783)
nodes.rationale: Engineered structured features at the tail of the 517-dim vector (509, 508, 505, 501, 504, 514, 500, 512, 513) dominate the ranking, with a few text-embedding dimensions (473, 24, 21, 232, 258) also contributing; importance is spread thin, showing no single trivially separating feature.

nodes.label: Constant Zero-Variance Features (511, 515, 516)
nodes.rationale: These features have blank rows in the heatmap and flat boxplots (511=0, 515=2, 516=3 for both classes), so they carry no information and are candidates for removal.

nodes.label: Feature 508/509 Collinearity (r = 0.94)
nodes.rationale: The two most important features are nearly redundant, so their combined Gini importance overstates independent signal; other notable pairs are 504-505 and 504-512 (0.58) and 502-504 (-0.50).

nodes.label: Feature Distribution Boxplots by Correlation Class (Features 509-516)
nodes.norm_label: feature distribution boxplots by correlation class (features 509-516)
nodes.rationale: Only Feature_509 separates classes clearly (mean ~0.36 non-correlated vs ~0.80 correlated); 510, 512, 513, 514 overlap heavily between classes, consistent with the hard-negative dataset design that prevents trivial separability.

nodes.label: HybridSecScan Hybrid Audit System
nodes.rationale: Integrating multiple security analysis methodologies overcomes the individual limitations of SAST and DAST; no integrated tools exist for REST APIs.

nodes.norm_label: synthetic sast-dast pair dataset (1,300 pairs, 517 features)

nodes.label: Domain Shift (TF-IDF vocabulary mismatch)
nodes.rationale: ML model produced no correlations on real data because TF-IDF vocabulary learned from synthetic descriptions does not match Semgrep/HTTP scanner output; retraining on real tool output is future work.

nodes.label: High Recall over Precision Trade-off
nodes.rationale: In security, missing a real vulnerability is worse than a false alarm, so the model favors recall (96.5% test) over precision (66.3%).

nodes.label: Random Forest Correlation Engine
nodes.rationale: Main thesis contribution: correlates SAST and DAST findings, reduces false positives with context filters, uses REST-API-specific features and computes confidence per finding.

nodes.label: Upload and Scan Security Validations
nodes.rationale: File type allowlist, size limit, UUID filenames, DAST URL validation, safe subprocess handling and timeouts to prevent abuse and hung scans.
